blockers.title: 171 product routes render PendingScreen
blockers.detail: Violates the no-placeholder rule. Cleared only when every PRODUCT entry renders a real component.

blockers.title: No capability is backed by real data
blockers.detail: No server, database, persistence or server-side authorization exists. Gates the Definition of Done for every screen.

blockers.title: Three GitHub PATs were exposed in chat and are not confirmed rotated
blockers.detail: Rotate, then add secret scanning to CI. Do not reuse the exposed credentials.

blockers.title: 191 rendered capabilities are mock-only
blockers.detail: They render, but read fixtures rather than an API. Cleared per capability as G4+ lands.

blockers.title: 112 rendering capabilities are visited but assert nothing
blockers.detail: The route is checked but no content assertion covers it. A visit with no assertion is the weakest possible test.

blockers.title: 104 built screens owe their designed mobile layout
blockers.detail: A .Mobile.dc.html exists and is not yet implemented. Card lists, not narrowed tables.

blockers.title: No modal system, so 23 CTAs do nothing
blockers.detail: Blocks every create/edit/delete flow in the ERP.

blockers.title: No tablet verification anywhere
blockers.detail: 768/820/834/1024, portrait and landscape, has never been checked.
